item.title: Read The Top News Headlines For Monday 2 February In One Click
item.description: Stay updated with the biggest headlines for Monday, 2 February - politics, crime, sports, and more - all summarized for quick reading. Get instant access to breaking news, major developments, and trending stories in just one click. Perfect for busy readers who want news on the go.

item.title: ICC demands fair play, warns PCB of long-term impact if boycott against India continues
item.description: The ICC has warned the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) that any decision to boycott the India vs Pakistan T20 World Cup 2026 match could have long-term consequences for Pakistan cricket.

item.title: Rohit Shetty Firing Case: Four accused sent to police custody; Bishnoi gang angle surfaces
item.description: Police have intensified the investigation into the firing incident outside filmmaker Rohit Shetty’s residence. Four accused from Pune have been arrested and sent to police custody till February 5 for their alleged role in planning the attack and arranging vehicles.

item.title: From record highs to reality check, Gold and Silver prices continue to fall; Check rates here
item.description: MCX gold prices opened sharply lower and slipped below the crucial ₹1.45 lakh per 10 gram mark, while silver prices cracked more than 3% amid weak investor sentiment.

item.title: Budget shock hits markets; Sensex and Nifty jumps in cautious recovery
item.description: Indian equity markets opened higher on Monday as Sensex gained 223 points and Nifty rose above 24,850, following Sunday’s sharp Budget-day sell-off triggered by the hike in STT on derivatives.

item.title: Magh Mela 2026 to continue after Magh month ends; Last ritual bath soon
item.description: Magh Mela 2026 in Prayagraj is ongoing and will continue until February 15. Thousands of devotees took a holy dip at Triveni Sangam on Magh Purnima, with Kalpvas participants completing their rituals.

item.title: Budget 2026: Overseas education becomes easier with lower TCS; Expert weigh in
item.description: The Union Budget 2026 has reduced the Tax Collected at Source (TCS) on overseas education remittances under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) from 5% to 2% for amounts exceeding ₹10 lakh.

item.title: Spiritual leader Dalai Lama receives first Grammy Award; Find out which category
item.description: The 14th Dalai Lama won his first-ever Grammy Award at the 68th Grammy Awards for his album ‘Spoken Word Meditations: The Reflections of His Holiness the Dalai Lama’.

item.title: Child rights groups welcome Budget 2026, Call it “Promising”; Details inside
item.description: Union Budget 2026 has raised allocations for child welfare in India by 14%, from ₹1,16,133 crore to ₹1,32,297 crore. Organizations like Just Rights for Children have welcomed the budget, highlighting increased support for education, skill development, and initiatives against child marriage.

item.title: Manipur Govt formation gathers pace as President’s rule ends on 12 Feb
item.description: The President's Rule was promulgated on 13 February 2025, days after Biren resigned and BJP legislators failed to reach a consensus about his replacement.
